tasks.label: Create GitHub Pages config and .gitignore
tasks.command:
mkdir -p .github/workflows
cat > .gitignore <<'EOF'
/.claude/
/docs/
/backup/
/ref/
/Project.md
.DS_Store
EOF
cat > .github/workflows/pages.yml <<'EOF'
name: GitHub Pages

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pages: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/configure-pages@v4
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v1
        with:
          path: ./
      - uses: actions/deploy-pages@v1
EOF

tasks.label: Check GitHub CLI
tasks.command: which gh && gh auth status || true

tasks.label: Initialize Git repository and commit
tasks.command: git init && git add . && git commit -m 'Initialize repository for GitHub Pages deployment'
